requirement: A private library MUST belong to a verified Bridge principal and be available with zero LMS connections.
Every metadata, object, job, cursor, cache and delivery operation MUST enforce owner and current permission, including just before release.
Accepted originals MUST persist across chats, restarts and LMS disconnect until the selected retention event.
A device upload MUST work through authenticated settings with byte progress, cancellation, retry and a durable per-file receipt.
A native host intake MUST use a supported explicit handoff; absence of the capability MUST lead to the browser path.
Intake MUST stream into quarantine, reserve quota and publish only after integrity and safety checks.
Idempotency and hash checks MUST prevent duplicate publication and silent consent expansion.
Storage, extraction, search, rendering and media playback capabilities MUST be reported separately.
Private collections, tags and titles MUST support bounded discovery without requiring a course or exposing another owner's metadata.
Reads/search MUST return bounded exact evidence, versions, coverage and continuation; omitted content MUST remain explicit.
Original-byte retrieval MUST reauthorize each request and verify the stored checksum; it MUST not depend on successful parsing.
Processing and recipient-specific text, visual, original and audio sharing MUST have distinct enforceable grants.
Imported origin and known institutional dependencies MUST survive rename, replacement, export and reimport checks.
Existing independent academic tools MUST consume permitted library sources through the shared evidence core.
Replacement MUST create immutable versions and invalidate dependent representations without silently updating citations.
Revocation/deletion MUST stop current and queued access, propagate to derived state and survive restoration.
Export and backup MUST be owner-scoped, encrypted where applicable, restorable and subject to deletion fences.
Enforced storage, item, transfer and processing quotas MUST be atomic across workers and visible to the owner.
New retention MUST not silently extend existing temporary imports or weaken institutional TTLs.
Original content, filenames, grants and private URLs MUST stay out of routine logs and public analytics.
Host, policy, parser and storage failures MUST produce actionable distinct states without fabricating success.
The UI MUST work with keyboard/screen reader, provide text equivalents and preserve the ChatGPT-first product.
Hosted release MUST pass multi-user isolation, migration, deletion/restore and exact-client acceptance.
Later audio/video and expanded archives MUST have explicit capability gates, bounded processing and synthetic acceptance.
